dialogues.speaker: Eymen
dialogues.text: Hello, welcome to Djafar Tavern. Come in.

dialogues.speaker: Eymen
dialogues.text: Djafar Tavern is always the right place for dining in Port Ormos.

dialogues.speaker: Eymen
dialogues.text: We offer the best wine, best food, and best service, all under this roof.

dialogues.speaker: Eymen
dialogues.text: You're family when you're here, regardless of where you're from!

dialogues.speaker: Eymen
dialogues.text: Hey, if it isn't my old customer!

dialogues.speaker: Eymen
dialogues.text: The truth is I was a traveling merchant in the desert before making enough money to start this establishment.

dialogues.speaker: Eymen
dialogues.text: Life was rough in the desert. The Eremites actually looked after me there, and that's why I helped those outlaws.

dialogues.speaker: Eymen
dialogues.text: But now I have nothing to do with them. You'll forgive me, right?

dialogues.speaker: Eymen
dialogues.text: Feel free to come back for some good wine anytime!

dialogues.speaker: Eymen
dialogues.text: And... And... I just managed to collect some "fine wine" every now and then for the business of the restaurant.

dialogues.speaker: Eymen
dialogues.text: Would you like to take some wine? Please take some, it's my sincere apology for what I did before.

dialogues.speaker: Eymen
dialogues.text: No wine? Then... Oh, I have this good sword given by an Eremite member. You can take that.

dialogues.speaker: Eymen
dialogues.text: Port Ormos is packed with people from all walks of life, you don't want to hang around here unguarded.
